(See CS–P 190.)
(a) The magnitude of the propeller blade vibration stresses under any normal condition of operation must be determined by actual measurement or by comparison with similar installations for which these measurements have been made.
(b) The determined vibration stresses may not exceed values that have been shown to be safe for continuous operation.
